admission.composition_failure: stable unavailable reason; no provider resend, chat corruption, fabricated zero, or fabricated exact usage
admission.malformed_extension: composition unavailable; base ProviderCallReceipt and RunBundle remain valid
admission.runtime_features: composition_availability_only; missing slugs never block ordinary V4/provider send, tools, interactions, or base RunBundle

electron_persistence.continuity: existing ProviderCallReceipt extension -> RunBundle -> bundle_json -> assistant meta.bundle -> TraceChain

privacy.digests: call-local envelope/route integrity evidence only; never displayed or indexed across users
privacy.persisted_content: only allowlisted category IDs, empty V1 subtype arrays, bounded counts/tokens/enums, and call-local integrity digests; raw/content-bearing fields fail closed

quality.overestimate: preserve category estimates; estimated or partial; residual null; coverage unreconciled; percentage null; never normalize to 100%
quality.reconciled: only reconciled_estimate has non-null residual and attributed+residual equality to receipt provider input total
quality.unreconciled: estimated or partial requires residual null and percentage null; provider-total unavailable also forces percentage null

selector_invariants.percentage: non-null only for reconciled_estimate with reported provider total and valid equality
selector_invariants.run_tree: deterministic set union of existing receipt set and all_call_ids; root/graph/subagent; each physical primary/retry/fallback receipt counted once
selector_invariants.unknown_or_corrupt: composition unavailable; never synthesize from legacy totals
